title: Eclipse Player Skin Manifest
description: manifest.json inside a .eclipseskin package. Specification: eclipse-player.md §11.3 (REQ-THM-015 … REQ-THM-019). Several REQ-THM-017 hard limits are expressed here where a schema can express them (entry count, layout-document count, font count, path length); the rest — total uncompressed size, per-entry compression ratio, image dimensions, and the per-directory caps of 16 layout documents and 8 fonts — are enforced by the installer BEFORE extraction. JSON Schema cannot count properties matching a pattern, so those caps deliberately live in code with their own tests rather than as an unenforceable comment here.

id.description: Stable identity. Two packages with the same id are the same skin at different versions.

license.description: SPDX identifier. The package also carries the full text in LICENSE (REQ-THM-015).

minAppVersion.description: REQ-THM-016. A skin declaring a newer app version than the running one is refused with a message naming both versions, not loaded partially.

capabilities.description: REQ-THM-016. Which tiers the package actually uses. A capability not listed here MUST NOT be honoured even if the corresponding directory is present — this is what makes the declaration load-bearing rather than decorative.

targetSurfaces.description: REQ-THM-016. Surfaces whose built-in layout this package overrides. Any surface not listed keeps the built-in layout (REQ-THM-032, graceful degradation).

preview.description: REQ-THM-015 fixes both the name and the 1280×800 dimensions; the field exists so the manifest is self-describing.

i18n.description: BCP-47 tags for which i18n/<lang>.json exists. Skin-authored strings only; never application strings.

checksums.description: REQ-THM-016: SHA-256 of every other file in the package, keyed by package-relative path. The installer verifies every entry AND refuses a package containing a file absent from this map — an unlisted file is the whole point of the check.

surface.description: Closed set. Adding a surface is a schemaVersion change (mirrors the closed component vocabulary of REQ-THM-026).

sha256.description: Lower-case hex. Case is fixed so comparison is a byte compare.

packagePath.description: REQ-THM-018 zip-slip prevention, expressed as an allowlist rather than a denylist: relative, ≤200 bytes, confined to a permitted top-level directory, depth ≤4, and structurally incapable of holding '..', an absolute prefix, a drive letter, a NUL, or a control character. manifest.json itself is excluded — it cannot checksum itself.
